#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Specific test for the nested CASE statement fix."""

import sqlvalidator
from sqlvalidator.grammar.tokeniser import get_tokens_until_one_of, to_tokens


def test_tokeniser_nested_case():
    """Test that get_tokens_until_one_of properly handles nested CASE statements."""
    # Test tokens for: CASE WHEN CASE WHEN x = 1 THEN 'a' END = 'a' THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END
    tokens = iter([
        "WHEN", 
        "CASE", "WHEN", "x", "=", "1", "THEN", "'a'", "END",  # inner CASE
        "=", "'a'", 
        "THEN", "'yes'", 
        "ELSE", "'no'",
        "END"  # outer CASE
    ])
    
    # Get tokens until the outer CASE's END
    result_tokens, next_token = get_tokens_until_one_of(tokens, ["end"], first_token="case")
    
    # Should capture everything up to and including the outer END's preceding tokens
    # but stop before consuming the final END token
    expected_tokens = [
        "case",  # first_token
        "WHEN", 
        "CASE", "WHEN", "x", "=", "1", "THEN", "'a'", "END",  # inner CASE fully captured
        "=", "'a'", 
        "THEN", "'yes'", 
        "ELSE", "'no'"
    ]
    
    assert result_tokens == expected_tokens
    assert next_token == "END"


def test_nested_case_parsing():
    """Test that nested CASE statements parse correctly."""
    # Test the exact case from the issue
    sql = """SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN CASE
    WHEN code = 1 THEN 'VALID'
    WHEN code = 2 THEN 'INVALID'
END
  = 'VALID' THEN 'OK'
  ELSE
  'KO'
END
FROM table"""

    parsed = sqlvalidator.parse(sql)
    assert parsed.is_valid(), f"Should be valid, but got errors: {parsed.errors}"
    
    # Test formatting works
    formatted = sqlvalidator.format_sql(sql)
    assert "CASE" in formatted
    assert "END" in formatted
    # Should have multiple END statements for nested CASEs
    end_count = formatted.count("END")
    assert end_count >= 2, f"Expected at least 2 END statements, got {end_count}"


def test_deeply_nested_case():
    """Test deeply nested CASE statements."""
    sql = """SELECT 
CASE 
  WHEN 
    CASE 
      WHEN 
        CASE x = 1 
        THEN TRUE 
        ELSE FALSE 
        END 
      THEN 'inner' 
      ELSE 'middle' 
    END 
  THEN 'outer' 
  ELSE 'none' 
END 
FROM table"""

    parsed = sqlvalidator.parse(sql)
    assert parsed.is_valid(), f"Should be valid, but got errors: {parsed.errors}"
    
    formatted = sqlvalidator.format_sql(sql)
    end_count = formatted.count("END")
    assert end_count >= 3, f"Expected at least 3 END statements, got {end_count}"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_tokeniser_nested_case()
    print("✓ Tokeniser nested CASE test passed")
    
    test_nested_case_parsing()
    print("✓ Nested CASE parsing test passed")
    
    test_deeply_nested_case()
    print("✓ Deeply nested CASE test passed")
    
    print("\n🎉 All nested CASE fix tests passed!")
